title: A Salt for the Crown Revisited
author: Wendell Iversen
blurb: Jude Dunmore, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
